name: Codex Security
works_with: Codex, a terminal CLI, a TypeScript SDK and GitHub Actions. Scans can run on OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, OpenRouter, Fireworks AI and Cheaper Inference
short: OpenAI's CLI and SDK that scan your code for security holes, check the findings are real and write patches.
what: Codex Security scans a repository, chosen paths or a Git diff for vulnerabilities, validates candidate findings, and can generate patches and verify fixes. It saves a report with source evidence, can draft a `SECURITY.md` and export threat models, SARIF, JSON and CSV. You can use it inside Codex, from the `cs` command, from the TypeScript SDK or in CI.
who: Developers and security teams who want an AI pass over their code for vulnerabilities, locally or in CI. Skip it if you cannot send your code to one of the supported model providers.
needs: A sign-in through `cs login`, an `OPENAI_API_KEY` or `CODEX_API_KEY` for CI, or another provider's credentials

steps.title: Install the CLI and sign in
steps.text: `cs` and `codex-security` run the same CLI. To skip the global install, use `npx @openai/codex-security` in place of `cs`.

steps.title: Run your first scan
steps.text: Run it from the repository folder, then open the Markdown file at the REPORT path it prints.

steps.title: Narrow the scope or go deeper
steps.code:
# Scan selected paths.
cs scan . --path src --path tests

# Scan committed changes from a base revision to HEAD.
cs scan . --diff origin/main

# Run a deep scan of the repository.
cs scan . --mode deep

steps.title: Draft a SECURITY.md
steps.text: It saves the draft outside the repository and leaves your files alone.

steps.title: Or use the SDK in a project

watch: Scans send your code to the model provider you sign in with.
The GitHub Actions example uses an estimated $5 limit per scan, and requests in progress can go over it. `cs scan --help` lists cost limits.
Some cybersecurity requests and protected findings need OpenAI's Trusted Access for Cyber.
The CI route needs an API key stored as a repository secret.
